purpose: Validate EUDR single-DDS rule compliance and supply-chain traceability: first operators file the DDS; downstream operators reference upstream DDS reference numbers from TRACES NT. Checks single-DDS rule, TRACES NT reference format validity, plot geolocation coverage, and custody-chain completeness. Returns chain_integrity verdict and traceability_gaps list. Feeds readiness diagnostic (art-170). Zero network, zero PII. Reg. EU 2023/1115 Art. 4.
